workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(berth_deposits_again) -> [PROVED]
intent_berth: none, because a defect does not route through /intent (CLAUDE.md: if editing lines of code fixes it, it is a ticket). Cast directly under the standing loop instruction to cast queue defects with /sorted.

watchme.trigger: on the beat, at rest - the same at-rest probe cadence the cairn device already runs; it needs no build to have happened, because the failure it watches for is the WORLD moving under a berth that never changed.
watchme.enough: two consecutive beats reporting zero provenance-refusals across every standing orient and constrain berth, where at least one of those beats follows a commit that changed the floor's answer for some berthed request. Zero alone is not enough: a corpus that has not moved cannot distinguish a fixed door from a quiet week, which is the shape that let a_pickup_is_witnessed.py read green off one August fact forever.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, naming the count of berths walked, the count refused, and for each refusal the field and its declared-vs-measured pair
watchme.consumer: CodeMother, as owner of the chart machines; escalates to Akien only on a refusal that is not a provenance disagreement

owner: CC builds it; CodeMother owns the chart machines whose doors change (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/orient and .../constrain).
